Create an IGW edge-associated route table with a valid
application-prefix endpoint route. Keep the firewall
subnet's onward Internet route distinct from the
workload subnet default. This page is a direct public-
workload example; ALB proxying changes tuples.
Limit ingress policy and workload SG to the intended
source/service. A packet can be allowed by Network
Firewall and still be dropped by SG/NACL. Content
visibility depends on TLS termination placement.

edge association exists and that the return does not
